## Falcon’s Beyond Highlights Role in Creative Design and Flagship Attraction Development for Mattel City


November 17, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/341371958/files/doc_news/Falcons-Beyond-Highlights-Role-in-Creative-Design-and-Flagship-Attraction-Development-for-Mattel-City-2026.pdf)


*Falcon’s Beyond highlights previously disclosed scope as lead creative designer for newly renamed Mattel City at VAI Resort*


ORLANDO, Fla:--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Falcon’s Beyond Global, Inc. (Nasdaq: FBYD) (“Falcon’s Beyond,” “Falcon’s,” or the “Company”), a global leader in visionary experiences and technologies, today highlighted its role providing lead creative design and attraction development services for the newly renamed[Mattel City](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fmattelcity.com%2F&esheet=54642449&newsitemid=20261117163121&lan=en-US&anchor=Mattel+City&index=1&md5=add978e0d562274600403cf1b3191b40) at VAI Resort in Glendale, Arizona.


Mattel City


As previously disclosed, Falcon’s Beyond entered into agreements with VAI Resort in May and June 2026 to provide attraction systems and lead design consulting services for a theme park development in Arizona. In connection with VAI Resort’s unveiling of the newly renamed Mattel City, Falcon’s is highlighting its role as the lead creative designer for the park, which is being expanded to transform the destination into a multi-day entertainment experience.


VAI Resort recently unveiled plans for a major expansion plan transforming the original Mattel Adventure Park concept into Mattel City, a larger themed entertainment destination spanning approximately 14 acres, up from the original nine-acre plan. VAI Resort announced that the reimagined development will feature 35 branded experiences inspired by Mattel’s iconic brands, including Barbie®, Monster High™, Masters of the Universe®, and Hot Wheels®, alongside immersive themed lands, new thrill rides, family attractions, themed dining, and expanded guest offerings. According to VAI Resort, the project will also add more than 800 hotel rooms across two themed hotel towers, creating a premier multi-day destination that extends far beyond the traditional theme park experience.


Falcon’s Beyond’s scope of work spans the full project lifecycle, from planning and design services to attraction design, technical execution, and attraction delivery, leveraging the Company's integrated capabilities. Through its creative design services, Falcon's will help to shape the guest experience through the development of attraction concepts, themed environments, public spaces, circulation planning, and the integration of immersive storytelling.


“We’re honored to help bring some of Mattel’s most beloved brands to life through a one-of-a-kind destination experience,” said **Cecil D. Magpuri, Chief Executive Officer of Falcon’s Beyond** . “At Falcon’s, we believe the world’s most memorable experiences begin with powerful stories. By bringing together the imaginative storytelling and experience design expertise of Falcon’s Creative with the attraction design, engineering, and ride systems capabilities of Falcon’s Attractions, we have a unique opportunity to create a destination that sparks imagination, inspires connection, and creates lasting memories for generations of guests.”


“As Mattel City evolved into a much larger and more ambitious destination, we needed a partner capable of helping shape both the vision and the execution,” said **Tommy Fisher** , **Owner of VAI Resort** . “Falcon’s Beyond brings a rare combination of strategic planning, creative vision, design expertise, and attraction delivery capabilities that few companies in the industry can offer. Their ability to seamlessly unite those disciplines made them the clear choice to help bring Mattel City to life.”


Mattel City will be Arizona’s first major theme park and a centerpiece of VAI Resort's broader entertainment destination in Glendale, Arizona. Designed as a four-season destination, the park will combine indoor and outdoor attractions with multiple acres of air-conditioned space, offering guests a comfortable entertainment experience year-round.


Falcon’s Beyond continues to earn recognition for its work on some of the world’s most ambitious destination developments. Earlier this year, Falcon’s received a World Waterpark Association Leading Edge Award for its contributions to Qiddiya Investment Company’s *Aquarabia Water Theme Park* in Saudi Arabia. For Aquarabia, Falcon’s led master planning and attraction design, developed the experiential vision and original intellectual property, and served as creative guardian throughout the project. Falcon’s was also recognized in 2026 with two Thea Awards for its work on Universal Epic Universe and *Harry Potter and the Battle at the Ministry* ™.


**About Falcon’s Beyond**


**Falcon’s Beyond** is a visionary entertainment and technology enterprise at the forefront of the global experience economy. We design, develop, engineer, deliver, and commercialize immersive physical and digital experiences for leading brands, developers, and destination operators worldwide, as well as for our own portfolio of entertainment and technology concepts. Our business is built on an integrated experience platform that brings together creative development, proprietary technologies, advanced engineering, intellectual property, and operational execution to enable the repeatable creation, deployment, and scaling of entertainment experiences across multiple formats and locations globally. We operate through three complementary business divisions:


- **Falcon’s Creative** , consisting of Falcon’s Creative Group and Falcon’s Beyond Creative, provides creative and advisory services including destination strategy, master planning, experiential and attraction design, digital media, interactive software, IP development, and creative guardianship for entertainment and hospitality destinations.
- **Falcon’s Beyond Brands** encompasses a broad portfolio of intellectual property, proprietary technologies, and operating businesses that design, engineer, commercialize, and deploy entertainment systems, products, content, and experiences across physical and digital environments.
- **Falcon’s Beyond Destinations** develops, owns, operates, and expands entertainment venues, hospitality experiences, and branded destination concepts across a variety of location‑based formats, utilizing proprietary and third‑party intellectual property.


FALCON’S BEYOND and its related trademarks are owned by Falcon’s Beyond.


Falcon’s is headquartered in Orlando, Fla. Learn more at[falconsbeyond.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ffalconsbeyond.com%2F&esheet=54642449&newsitemid=20261117163121&lan=en-US&anchor=falconsbeyond.com&index=2&md5=d997f45f460cdefb6c7cba02264644f3) .

**About VAI RESORT**


VAI Resort is a first-of-its-kind entertainment resort in Glendale, Ariz., bringing hospitality, live entertainment, dining and immersive attractions together in one destination. Set to become Arizona’s largest hotel and entertainment resort, VAI will feature more than 2,000 rooms, suites and villas; 13 signature restaurants, including Bar Mar by José Andrés; Konos Island; a luxury spa; curated retail; a conference center; and a multi-level indoor theater. The destination will also be home to the world’s first Mattel City, the 15,000-seat VAI Amphitheater and a 130-foot-high sky bar ride. Developed by VAI Global Development, the resort is designed to deliver an unparalleled multi-day entertainment experience in the heart of Glendale.
